note: Production code (GeoPrivacyRules.IsMoreRestrictive/AllowInclude, BuildGeoPeerTableForIndex, parseGeoEntity, ze-mrt-conf.yang) enforces all four RFC 6397 Section 6 GEOPRIV default rules and the non-technical-measures override. Positive polarity proves each restrictive rule independently excludes coordinates (emitted as NaN, NaN) end-to-end through ParseConfig -> DumpRIB -> mrt.ReadFile with non-technical-measures=false: retransmission-allowed=false (peer 2), retention-years=99 boundary <100 (peer 3), non-empty ruleset-reference (peer 4), and non-empty note-well (peer 5 and collector). Negative polarity proves default privacy (peer 0) and restrictive rules with non-technical-measures=true (peer 6) include WGS84 coordinates end-to-end. Discrimination proofs cite GeoPrivacyRules.AllowInclude.
